claim: Tests whether reasoning-enabled Duck reaches ls20 G3 NAV without a repeated read-only loop, then learns floor and refused edges, keeps confirmation bound to contact, releases an exhausted target provisionally, and reopens topology after a masked world delta.
claim_limits: This canary does not grade competition score, level completion, or the full gate stack.
Criteria not reached inside the narrow budget remain ungraded rather than failed.
The reasoning-enabled profile restores the productive v3 settings; this remains a behavior test, not a controlled model comparison.
Human review of lossless artifacts is required before claiming behavioral success.

inference_profile.purpose: reasoning-enabled one-world gate checkpoint; not a model-quality comparison

infrastructure_criteria: I0: the shipped source holds no tools/live_level_carry_gate.py and no world name in the solver's executable code other than the harness's public game roster (packager guard).
I1: G0 assigns NAVIGATION from metadata, and the controller executor is on (probe envelopes carry executor CONTROLLER and the protocol stamp g3_inherits_g2_nulls true).
I2: the downloaded execution receipt is byte-identical to the package receipt.
I3: the run writes the memory artifacts: turn ledger, gate answers with executor, probe envelopes, control-map evidence, and contact epochs where reached.
I4: approach and contact remain distinct in recorded evidence and only contact can advance G4.
live_criteria: C0: repeated read-only inspection recovers after one correction or ends promptly as controlled_stop: no_progress_tool_loop; it never consumes the outer time cap.
C1: G0-G2 open G3 on ls20 with a demonstrated NAV control map and total counter mask.
C2: a failed APPROACH becomes a refused (stand, action) edge and the unchanged edge is not immediately retried.
C3: a pending NAV lever confirmation remains ROUTING and ungraded until terminal contact.
C4: exhaustion, if reached, produces an evidence-bound PRESUMED_UNREACHABLE explanation, advances the ranked target, and makes no inertness claim.
C5: any non-counter, non-ego world delta invalidates old-state refusal evidence and reopens provisional reachability conclusions.
C6: the run ends at planned stop, controlled no-progress stop, or the explicit 96-action/2700-second cap without crashing.
precondition: Gate criteria are graded only when the run reaches that gate; a stall earlier leaves them ungraded, not failed. All measurements come from artifact state (turn ledger, gate events, gate answers, probe envelopes, annotations), not from prose.
revisions: R9-R19 plus G3 NAV terrain/reachability and R9-I03 no-progress guard
source_delivery: Kaggle may mount src/ directly or transport it as src.zip; the notebook verifies extracted files before imports.
